proof_body:
by
  intro r C t hne
  have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => -(r * s)) (-(r * 1)) t :=
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul r).neg
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => 1 + C * Real.exp (-(r * s)))
      (C * (Real.exp (-(r * t)) * (-(r * 1)))) t := (h0.exp.const_mul C).const_add 1
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s => 1 / (1 + C * Real.exp (-(r * s))))
      ((0 * (1 + C * Real.exp (-(r * t))) - 1 * (C * (Real.exp (-(r * t)) * (-(r * 1))))) /
        (1 + C * Real.exp (-(r * t))) ^ 2) t := (hasDerivAt_const t (1 : ℝ)).div h1 hne
  refine h2.congr_deriv ?_
  field_simp
  ring
target_source: ∀ (r C t : ℝ), 1 + C * Real.exp (-(r * t)) ≠ 0 → HasDerivAt (fun s => 1 / (1 + C * Real.exp (-(r * s)))) (r * (1 / (1 + C * Real.exp (-(r * t)))) * (1 - 1 / (1 + C * Real.exp (-(r * t))))) t
